data.body:
MERGED and CLOSED. Gerrit change 1206 landed on main as commit ae009443a9 ("b9b8: mirror a Jira-side
title edit inbound"), LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

Closing with `--ref ae009443a9` rather than moving a worktree HEAD: several agents are working
concurrently and two share the main worktree, so pointing the completion verifier at the fix's own
committed tree is both safer and more precise.

THE FIX RESTORES WHAT AN ADR ALREADY MANDATED, which is why it is a defect repair rather than a
behaviour change. `outbound_field_diff._INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS` held FOUR fields
(description/priority/status/assignee) with a comment declaring `title` "deliberately absent". ADR
0026 line 24 says otherwise, verbatim: "the five inbound-mirrored scalar fields
(`title`/`description`/`priority`/`status`/`assignee`)". The code had drifted from its own ADR, and
the consequence was precisely the reported symptom — a Jira-side summary edit on an unmodified local
title was reverted by outbound local-wins instead of mirroring inbound.

VERIFIED BEFORE LANDING, not taken on trust from the agent that wrote it:
  * the ADR citation was checked at source (`docs/adr/0026-reconciler-three-way-merge-baseline.md`);
  * 9 new unit cells pass in `diffing/test_inbound_field_sync_directionality.py`;
  * MUTATION-CHECKED: removing `title` from the mirrored set turns exactly one cell RED
    ("a Jira-side title edit must mirror inbound, not be reverted"), and the other 8 keep passing;
  * NO REGRESSION across the blast radius — 536 tests pass over `diffing` + `mutate`, the two
    suites that own direction arbitration;
  * `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean.

CLASS: preexisting. The four-field set predates this epic; DC merely exposed it, because the live
mutation table asserts a Jira-side summary edit per-field where no prior test did.

The live cell `test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[02-edit-summary]` should now go green; that is
confirmation, not the evidence for this close, and it belongs to [rebar:5200-e04e-246e-4aae].
